Add a save RPC that accepts the existing report options and an absolute `savePath` on the server host. Save the report, selected attachments, and a manifest without uploading, and return `savedPath`, `threadId`, and `promptHash`. Local exports remain available when uploads are disabled by configuration.

Publish archives atomically without replacing existing files. Bound uncompressed contents to 200 MiB and attachments to 128, preserve duplicate attachment names safely, and fail without publishing a partial ZIP when a selected file cannot be read. Honor `includeLogs` and omit automatic rollouts for untouched threads without materializing them.

Update protocol schemas and generated TypeScript and Python types.

Add coverage for local-only saves, disabled uploads, path validation, overwrite protection, log consent, archive budgets, duplicate names, missing files, and rollout selection before materialization and after writer shutdown.

## Why

Installed-plugin inventory fetches could keep following pagination cursors

timeout cancellation after successful pages. Verify that failed pagination

Refresh cloud plugin and skill catalogs after mid-turn auth changes (#55957)

## What changed

- Add a `refresh_catalog_for_step` lifecycle hook and rebuild MCP when plugin catalogs change.
- Reuse successful discovery within a turn and auth scope, serialize concurrent refreshes, and allow retries after failures or cancellation. Limit cloud skill discovery warnings to once per turn.
- Skip cloud discovery during prewarm and other context-only captures, and check hosted plugins even when no executor roots are selected.

commits.message:
Preserve provider model catalogs when refreshes fail (#55958)

## Why

A failed provider catalog refresh could discard model metadata and disable tool search on subsequent turns, even after a successful discovery.

## What changed

Keep the last successful catalog, ETag, and original freshness when refreshes fail without an access rejection. Continue invalidating cached catalogs for HTTP `401`/`403`, rejected refresh tokens, and gateway credentials that require login. Successful empty responses remain authoritative, and cached catalogs remain scoped to the provider and authentication identity.

## Why

Failed cloud discovery previously retried before each model step. Apply a cooldown across steps and turns to avoid repeated discovery requests while a provider remains unavailable.

## What changed

- Share per-thread retry backoff logic between cloud skill and plugin catalogs, starting at 30 seconds and doubling to a maximum of 5 minutes.
- Scope cooldowns to authentication and MCP resource generations so account changes and reconnects permit immediate recovery.
- Clear backoff after successful discovery or configuration resets, while allowing cancelled refreshes to retry immediately.

Drain WebSocket responses on mailbox preemption (#55969)

## Why

Mailbox preemption can discard completed response items and lose the response ID needed for incremental continuation. Buffered tool calls must also wait for queued agent messages to be read.

## What changed

- Gracefully interrupt and drain Responses Lite streams, retaining completed items and the response ID for the next request.
- Cancel buffered tool calls before dispatch and suppress partial items that may be discarded during the drain.
- Keep user steering queued until draining finishes. Include pending mail in follow-up requests after disconnects and preserve content-filter recovery guidance.

## Testing

Add WebSocket regression coverage for buffered completion, interrupts without acknowledgement, buffered tools and partial items, user steering during draining, disconnects, and content-filter recovery.

## What changed

Add `codex migrate-nfs-db` to replace configured SQLite WAL databases in place with validated copies in `DELETE` journal mode, retaining the originals and their sidecar files in backup directories. Stage conversion locally, check database integrity before installation, and support resuming an interrupted replacement.

commits.title: Refresh remote exec-server credentials after unauthorized responses (#55987)
commits.message:
Refresh remote exec-server credentials after unauthorized responses (#55987)

## Why

Remote registry requests need to recover when credentials are rejected or rotated while `exec-server` is running. Concurrent requests should reuse refreshed credentials rather than refresh the replacement token again.

## What changed

- Add an `AuthProvider` recovery hook and retry registry registration, connection, and harness-key validation once after a `401` when the provider supplies replacement credentials.
- Use live ChatGPT authentication for remote `exec-server` and guard proactive and unauthorized refreshes so concurrent callers share the completed refresh.
- Allow executor credentials to retry when the parent has already supplied a valid replacement.
- Keep connection authentication, refresh, and retry within the original connection deadline.

## Testing

Add coverage for concurrent refreshes, stored and parent-supplied credential rotation, refresh failures, retry limits, and connection deadlines, plus a CLI integration test for refresh and credential reload in a running executor.

commits.title: Scope MITM credential substitution to trusted origins and placeholders (#56003)
commits.message:
Scope MITM credential substitution to trusted origins and placeholders (#56003)

## Why

Credential substitution needs to authorize the destination and the original request before exposing host secrets. Project configuration must not redirect trusted credential policies, and older clients must reject scoped policies rather than silently apply unconditional injection.

## What changed

- Add hook `schemes` and `ports` constraints and an exact whole-header `placeholder` for secret substitution. Require `network.mitm.version = 2` for these options in permission profiles.
- Restrict placeholder substitution to HTTPS on port 443 and reject missing, mismatched, or duplicate placeholder headers.
- Reject project changes to trusted MITM definitions and their inheritance chains. Allow self-contained project header-stripping policies only when no trusted MITM policy exists.
- Reject ambiguous query values, value-constrained headers, and semicolon paths during authorization, and preserve case-sensitive extension methods.
- Mark resolved secret headers sensitive, reject secret injection into `User-Agent`, restrict substitution headers, and limit secret files to 64 KiB.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for scoped TOML resolution, legacy-format rejection, unknown fields, project policy restrictions, origin and placeholder denials, ambiguous request matching, secret redaction, and hook application after credential brokerage.

commits.title: Scope MITM credential substitution to trusted origins and placeholders (#56003)
commits.message:
Scope MITM credential substitution to trusted origins and placeholders (#56003)

## Why

Credential substitution needs to authorize the destination and the original request before exposing host secrets. Project configuration must not redirect trusted credential policies, and older clients must reject scoped policies rather than silently apply unconditional injection.

## What changed

- Add hook `schemes` and `ports` constraints and an exact whole-header `placeholder` for secret substitution. Require `network.mitm.version = 2` for these options in permission profiles.
- Restrict placeholder substitution to HTTPS on port 443 and reject missing, mismatched, or duplicate placeholder headers.
- Reject project changes to trusted MITM definitions and their inheritance chains. Allow self-contained project header-stripping policies only when no trusted MITM policy exists.
- Reject ambiguous query values, value-constrained headers, and semicolon paths during authorization, and preserve case-sensitive extension methods.
- Mark resolved secret headers sensitive, reject secret injection into `User-Agent`, restrict substitution headers, and limit secret files to 64 KiB.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for scoped TOML resolution, legacy-format rejection, unknown fields, project policy restrictions, origin and placeholder denials, ambiguous request matching, secret redaction, and hook application after credential brokerage.

## Why

Runtime process handles are recyclable and thread-local. Using them as terminal session identities can merge separate commands or associate `write_stdin` operations with the wrong exec.

## What changed

- Give each exec a distinct terminal session and track the latest session for each thread-local process handle.
- Record the exec selected by `write_stdin` at runtime and use it to correct session membership during replay, including when dispatch is delayed until a handle is reused.
- Fall back to the latest session for the thread and handle when replaying older traces without runtime target events.

## Testing

commits.title: Cache decrypted Codex auth and managed secrets (#56081)
commits.message:
Cache decrypted Codex auth and managed secrets (#56081)

## Why

Repeated reads of Codex auth and managed secrets repeat expensive scrypt decryption even when the encrypted file and keyring passphrase are unchanged.

## What changed

Extend the decrypted snapshot cache to `CodexAuth` and `ManagedSecrets`, keeping at most one snapshot per namespace. Reuse snapshots only when the file path, ciphertext, and passphrase match, and invalidate matching snapshots on writes. Every read still checks the file and keyring before reusing plaintext.

## Testing

Extend cache tests to cover concurrent reuse, writes, external file replacement, file removal, key rotation, keyring errors, invalid ciphertext, and isolation across homes and namespaces. Prime the auth cache before verifying fallback when the keyring fails.

commits.title: Honor server approval reviewer defaults on fresh TUI startup (#56090)
commits.message:
Honor server approval reviewer defaults on fresh TUI startup (#56090)

## Why

A saved client `approvals_reviewer` setting could override the app server's default when starting a fresh thread.

## What changed

Use explicit invocation overrides for the first thread's approval reviewer, leaving the selection to the server when no override is provided. Typed overrides take precedence over key-value overrides, and repeated key-value overrides use the last value. Explicit profile launches retain their resolved configuration behavior.

## Testing

Extend startup tests to cover server defaults, embedded startup, explicit override precedence, and profile launches. Verify that the first turn uses the reviewer returned by the server.

## Why

Saving a local preference could succeed but fail to apply live because reloading the full configuration also resolved execution settings. An unknown `model_provider`, for example, prevented the preference from taking effect.

## What changed

Reload config-panel preferences from the configuration layer stack into `LocalSettings` without rebuilding execution settings. Preserve CLI overrides, loader overrides, cloud configuration, and the existing choice of working directory.

## Testing

Extend the offline remote-session preference test with an unknown `model_provider` override, verifying that automatic recap and paste detection preferences still persist and apply live.

- Shut down all supplied sessions on startup errors, cancellation, and early exits.

## What changed

Add the disabled-by-default `guardian_recorded_items` feature to forward recorded reviewer items and interruptions through the parent's raw-event subscription, preserving reviewer thread and turn IDs without modifying the parent's history or completing its turn.

Emit reviewer items as `rawResponseItem/completed` notifications and interruptions as interrupted `turn/completed` notifications. Mark opted-in reviewer requests with `guardian_recorded_items` metadata.

commits.title: Avoid blocking EMA auth status checks on account refresh (#56127)
commits.message:
Avoid blocking EMA auth status checks on account refresh (#56127)

## Why

EMA MCP auth status checks acquired an account grant lease, making status inspection wait for account refresh coordination or an existing lease.

## What changed

Add `AuthManager::account_oauth_grant()` to inspect an owner-checked grant without acquiring the refresh lock. Use it for EMA status checks and share a single lazy read across servers, including missing grants and read errors. Keep refresh exclusion for token exchanges through `lease_account_oauth_grant()`.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for status checks across two EMA servers while an account lease is held. Extend account refresh tests to verify inspection completes with a lease held and refresh queued, and returns no grant after logout.

commits.message:
Cancel MCP tool requests when response futures are dropped (#56132)

## Why

Dropping a local tool-call future did not notify the MCP server that the request was cancelled, leaving remote work running.

## What changed

- Send a cancellation notification for the request when its response future is dropped, covering both ordinary tool calls and tool-input rounds.
- Preserve write order for stdio and in-process transports so cancellation cannot arrive before its tool request, without waiting for tool responses.

## Testing

Add regression tests for cancellation on drop, request-before-cancellation ordering under reversed send polling and exhausted task budgets, and continued use of the shared connection after cancellation.

commits.message:

## Why

An explicit `final_answer` with empty or whitespace-only text could allow queued agent mail to restart the turn instead of leaving it queued for the next turn.

## What changed

Treat explicit `final_answer` messages as terminal regardless of visible text in both completed-item handling and turn-item finalization. Untagged messages still require visible text to defer mailbox delivery; `commentary` and `partial_answer` messages do not defer it.

## Testing

Extend regression coverage for empty and whitespace-only final answers, delivery of queued agent mail on the next turn, and message board notifications arriving before or after an empty final answer.

commits.title: Cache decrypted Codex auth and managed secrets (#56081)
commits.message:
Cache decrypted Codex auth and managed secrets (#56081)

## Why

Repeated reads of Codex auth and managed secrets repeat expensive scrypt decryption even when the encrypted file and keyring passphrase are unchanged.

## What changed

Extend the decrypted snapshot cache to `CodexAuth` and `ManagedSecrets`, keeping at most one snapshot per namespace. Reuse snapshots only when the file path, ciphertext, and passphrase match, and invalidate matching snapshots on writes. Every read still checks the file and keyring before reusing plaintext.

## Testing

Extend cache tests to cover concurrent reuse, writes, external file replacement, file removal, key rotation, keyring errors, invalid ciphertext, and isolation across homes and namespaces. Prime the auth cache before verifying fallback when the keyring fails.

GitOrigin-RevId: eaf802ef4cfdbe482b56423807a1fe0fe3def2cd

commits.title: Honor server approval reviewer defaults on fresh TUI startup (#56090)
commits.message:
Honor server approval reviewer defaults on fresh TUI startup (#56090)

## Why

A saved client `approvals_reviewer` setting could override the app server's default when starting a fresh thread.

## What changed

Use explicit invocation overrides for the first thread's approval reviewer, leaving the selection to the server when no override is provided. Typed overrides take precedence over key-value overrides, and repeated key-value overrides use the last value. Explicit profile launches retain their resolved configuration behavior.

## Testing

Extend startup tests to cover server defaults, embedded startup, explicit override precedence, and profile launches. Verify that the first turn uses the reviewer returned by the server.

GitOrigin-RevId: 19d4d75bb8fbe522fb9495bd9c6951513f8ac4d2

commits.title: Keep TUI preferences editable when execution settings are invalid (#56091)
commits.message:
Keep TUI preferences editable when execution settings are invalid (#56091)

## Why

Saving a local preference could succeed but fail to apply live because reloading the full configuration also resolved execution settings. An unknown `model_provider`, for example, prevented the preference from taking effect.

## What changed

Reload config-panel preferences from the configuration layer stack into `LocalSettings` without rebuilding execution settings. Preserve CLI overrides, loader overrides, cloud configuration, and the existing choice of working directory.

## Testing

Extend the offline remote-session preference test with an unknown `model_provider` override, verifying that automatic recap and paste detection preferences still persist and apply live.

GitOrigin-RevId: 2377a01c77f3cb978a7ee6cd67c1fe89361131fb

commits.title: Prepare TUI startup to accept multiple backend sessions (#56097)
commits.message:
Prepare TUI startup to accept multiple backend sessions (#56097)

## What changed

- Add `InitialBackendSessions` to carry the initial session and additional sessions into the TUI event loop. Existing launches continue to supply a single session.
- Shut down all supplied sessions on startup errors, cancellation, and early exits.
- Register the under-development `tui_multi_backend` feature flag, disabled by default, and expose it in the configuration schema.

## Testing

Add a regression test that fails bootstrap and verifies that both initial backends receive shutdown requests. Update multi-source event polling coverage to use the new initialization path.

GitOrigin-RevId: e5db439552de97594e6f13360b90be71256ab2f0

commits.title: Forward Guardian reviewer events to parent raw-event subscribers (#56124)
commits.message:
Forward Guardian reviewer events to parent raw-event subscribers (#56124)

## What changed

Add the disabled-by-default `guardian_recorded_items` feature to forward recorded reviewer items and interruptions through the parent's raw-event subscription, preserving reviewer thread and turn IDs without modifying the parent's history or completing its turn.

Emit reviewer items as `rawResponseItem/completed` notifications and interruptions as interrupted `turn/completed` notifications. Mark opted-in reviewer requests with `guardian_recorded_items` metadata.

## Testing

Extend Guardian integration tests to cover reviewer identity, recorded-item metadata replay, concurrent reviewer interruptions, independent parent completion, and behavior without the feature enabled.

GitOrigin-RevId: beb4dbf6c6f2a800a2fbf3cfd11ae174a1382386

commits.title: Avoid blocking EMA auth status checks on account refresh (#56127)
commits.message:
Avoid blocking EMA auth status checks on account refresh (#56127)

## Why

EMA MCP auth status checks acquired an account grant lease, making status inspection wait for account refresh coordination or an existing lease.

## What changed

Add `AuthManager::account_oauth_grant()` to inspect an owner-checked grant without acquiring the refresh lock. Use it for EMA status checks and share a single lazy read across servers, including missing grants and read errors. Keep refresh exclusion for token exchanges through `lease_account_oauth_grant()`.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for status checks across two EMA servers while an account lease is held. Extend account refresh tests to verify inspection completes with a lease held and refresh queued, and returns no grant after logout.

GitOrigin-RevId: 921214dd552eb216c713596f2737460053a07d08

commits.title: Cancel MCP tool requests when response futures are dropped (#56132)
commits.message:
Cancel MCP tool requests when response futures are dropped (#56132)

## Why

Dropping a local tool-call future did not notify the MCP server that the request was cancelled, leaving remote work running.

## What changed

- Send a cancellation notification for the request when its response future is dropped, covering both ordinary tool calls and tool-input rounds.
- Preserve write order for stdio and in-process transports so cancellation cannot arrive before its tool request, without waiting for tool responses.

## Testing

Add regression tests for cancellation on drop, request-before-cancellation ordering under reversed send polling and exhausted task budgets, and continued use of the shared connection after cancellation.

GitOrigin-RevId: fab02d546fd82c601756117d9ecbf1017c28ac11

commits.title: Defer agent mail after empty final answers (#56133)
commits.message:
Defer agent mail after empty final answers (#56133)

## Why

An explicit `final_answer` with empty or whitespace-only text could allow queued agent mail to restart the turn instead of leaving it queued for the next turn.

## What changed

Treat explicit `final_answer` messages as terminal regardless of visible text in both completed-item handling and turn-item finalization. Untagged messages still require visible text to defer mailbox delivery; `commentary` and `partial_answer` messages do not defer it.

## Testing

Extend regression coverage for empty and whitespace-only final answers, delivery of queued agent mail on the next turn, and message board notifications arriving before or after an empty final answer.

GitOrigin-RevId: 466f1a9c613e07d67ce45458858ba32d5d23f11d

Reload config-panel preferences from the configuration layer stack into `LocalSettings` without rebuilding execution settings. Preserve CLI overrides, loader overrides, cloud configuration, and the existing choice of working directory.

## Testing

Extend the offline remote-session preference test with an unknown `model_provider` override, verifying that automatic recap and paste detection preferences still persist and apply live.

commits.title: Prepare TUI startup to accept multiple backend sessions (#56097)
commits.message:
Prepare TUI startup to accept multiple backend sessions (#56097)

## What changed

- Add `InitialBackendSessions` to carry the initial session and additional sessions into the TUI event loop. Existing launches continue to supply a single session.
- Shut down all supplied sessions on startup errors, cancellation, and early exits.
- Register the under-development `tui_multi_backend` feature flag, disabled by default, and expose it in the configuration schema.

## Testing

Add a regression test that fails bootstrap and verifies that both initial backends receive shutdown requests. Update multi-source event polling coverage to use the new initialization path.

commits.title: Forward Guardian reviewer events to parent raw-event subscribers (#56124)
commits.message:
Forward Guardian reviewer events to parent raw-event subscribers (#56124)

## What changed

Add the disabled-by-default `guardian_recorded_items` feature to forward recorded reviewer items and interruptions through the parent's raw-event subscription, preserving reviewer thread and turn IDs without modifying the parent's history or completing its turn.

Emit reviewer items as `rawResponseItem/completed` notifications and interruptions as interrupted `turn/completed` notifications. Mark opted-in reviewer requests with `guardian_recorded_items` metadata.

## Testing

Extend Guardian integration tests to cover reviewer identity, recorded-item metadata replay, concurrent reviewer interruptions, independent parent completion, and behavior without the feature enabled.

commits.title: Avoid blocking EMA auth status checks on account refresh (#56127)
commits.message:
Avoid blocking EMA auth status checks on account refresh (#56127)

## Why

EMA MCP auth status checks acquired an account grant lease, making status inspection wait for account refresh coordination or an existing lease.

## What changed

Add `AuthManager::account_oauth_grant()` to inspect an owner-checked grant without acquiring the refresh lock. Use it for EMA status checks and share a single lazy read across servers, including missing grants and read errors. Keep refresh exclusion for token exchanges through `lease_account_oauth_grant()`.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for status checks across two EMA servers while an account lease is held. Extend account refresh tests to verify inspection completes with a lease held and refresh queued, and returns no grant after logout.

GitOrigin-RevId: 921214dd552eb216c713596f2737460053a07d08

commits.title: Cancel MCP tool requests when response futures are dropped (#56132)
commits.message:
Cancel MCP tool requests when response futures are dropped (#56132)

## Why

Dropping a local tool-call future did not notify the MCP server that the request was cancelled, leaving remote work running.

## What changed

- Send a cancellation notification for the request when its response future is dropped, covering both ordinary tool calls and tool-input rounds.
- Preserve write order for stdio and in-process transports so cancellation cannot arrive before its tool request, without waiting for tool responses.

## Testing

Add regression tests for cancellation on drop, request-before-cancellation ordering under reversed send polling and exhausted task budgets, and continued use of the shared connection after cancellation.

GitOrigin-RevId: fab02d546fd82c601756117d9ecbf1017c28ac11

commits.title: Defer agent mail after empty final answers (#56133)
commits.message:
Defer agent mail after empty final answers (#56133)

## Why

An explicit `final_answer` with empty or whitespace-only text could allow queued agent mail to restart the turn instead of leaving it queued for the next turn.

## What changed

Treat explicit `final_answer` messages as terminal regardless of visible text in both completed-item handling and turn-item finalization. Untagged messages still require visible text to defer mailbox delivery; `commentary` and `partial_answer` messages do not defer it.

## Testing

Extend regression coverage for empty and whitespace-only final answers, delivery of queued agent mail on the next turn, and message board notifications arriving before or after an empty final answer.

releaseNotes.body:
## New Features

- Save reusable prompts and slash commands in ten numbered `/presets` slots, with a keyboard menu for quick access. (#54380, #54381)
- Set model, reasoning effort, speed, and permission profiles directly with inline `/model` and `/permissions` arguments. (#54378, #54383)
- Preview viewed and generated images in the fullscreen transcript on terminals supporting Kitty or Sixel graphics. (#54216)
- Authenticate enterprise MCP connections using eligible Codex account grants or dedicated sign-in, including OAuth clients requiring secrets. (#55334, #55859, #56001)
- Mask credentials during supported remote Bash commands and Zsh snapshot sessions, including credentials from custom providers. (#54309, #54432, #56049)
- The Amazon Bedrock setup wizard is now enabled by default, with API key entry grouped alongside other AWS sign-in methods when credentials are detected. (#56033, #56023)

## Bug Fixes

- Failed compaction no longer leaves partial summaries in conversation history, and background compaction failures fall back without panicking. (#53932, #55581)
- Resuming sessions now finds compressed histories and restores saved thread settings instead of replacing them with global defaults. (#54008, #55923)
- Windows HTTPS and WebSocket connections now handle proxy authentication challenges using the signed-in user’s Negotiate or NTLM credentials. (#55994, #56000)
- CLI configuration overrides are preserved when `-c` or `--config` appears at multiple subcommand levels. (#56022)
- Queued prompts now wait for pending permission selections to resolve before continuing. (#55682)
- Hardened sandbox checks for case-variant metadata paths on macOS and replaceable symlinks used to locate executables. (#54273, #55384)

## Chores

- Reduced disk usage by pruning unused installations, cleaning abandoned marketplace checkouts, and bounding daemon logs. (#53827, #55149, #55689, #55690, #55856)
- Updated the embedded JavaScript runtime with safety checks for optimized `Array.sort` operations. (#54519)

notes.body:
## New Features

- Save reusable prompts and slash commands in ten numbered `/presets` slots, with a keyboard menu for quick access. (#54380, #54381)
- Set model, reasoning effort, speed, and permission profiles directly with inline `/model` and `/permissions` arguments. (#54378, #54383)
- Preview viewed and generated images in the fullscreen transcript on terminals supporting Kitty or Sixel graphics. (#54216)
- Authenticate enterprise MCP connections using eligible Codex account grants or dedicated sign-in, including OAuth clients requiring secrets. (#55334, #55859, #56001)
- Mask credentials during supported remote Bash commands and Zsh snapshot sessions, including credentials from custom providers. (#54309, #54432, #56049)
- The Amazon Bedrock setup wizard is now enabled by default, with API key entry grouped alongside other AWS sign-in methods when credentials are detected. (#56033, #56023)

## Bug Fixes

- Failed compaction no longer leaves partial summaries in conversation history, and background compaction failures fall back without panicking. (#53932, #55581)
- Resuming sessions now finds compressed histories and restores saved thread settings instead of replacing them with global defaults. (#54008, #55923)
- Windows HTTPS and WebSocket connections now handle proxy authentication challenges using the signed-in user’s Negotiate or NTLM credentials. (#55994, #56000)
- CLI configuration overrides are preserved when `-c` or `--config` appears at multiple subcommand levels. (#56022)
- Queued prompts now wait for pending permission selections to resolve before continuing. (#55682)
- Hardened sandbox checks for case-variant metadata paths on macOS and replaceable symlinks used to locate executables. (#54273, #55384)

## Chores

- Reduced disk usage by pruning unused installations, cleaning abandoned marketplace checkouts, and bounding daemon logs. (#53827, #55149, #55689, #55690, #55856)
- Updated the embedded JavaScript runtime with safety checks for optimized `Array.sort` operations. (#54519)

commits.title: Cache decrypted Codex auth and managed secrets (#56081)
commits.message:
Cache decrypted Codex auth and managed secrets (#56081)

## Why

Repeated reads of Codex auth and managed secrets repeat expensive scrypt decryption even when the encrypted file and keyring passphrase are unchanged.

## What changed

Extend the decrypted snapshot cache to `CodexAuth` and `ManagedSecrets`, keeping at most one snapshot per namespace. Reuse snapshots only when the file path, ciphertext, and passphrase match, and invalidate matching snapshots on writes. Every read still checks the file and keyring before reusing plaintext.

## Testing

Extend cache tests to cover concurrent reuse, writes, external file replacement, file removal, key rotation, keyring errors, invalid ciphertext, and isolation across homes and namespaces. Prime the auth cache before verifying fallback when the keyring fails.

GitOrigin-RevId: eaf802ef4cfdbe482b56423807a1fe0fe3def2cd

commits.title: Honor server approval reviewer defaults on fresh TUI startup (#56090)
commits.message:
Honor server approval reviewer defaults on fresh TUI startup (#56090)

## Why

A saved client `approvals_reviewer` setting could override the app server's default when starting a fresh thread.

## What changed

Use explicit invocation overrides for the first thread's approval reviewer, leaving the selection to the server when no override is provided. Typed overrides take precedence over key-value overrides, and repeated key-value overrides use the last value. Explicit profile launches retain their resolved configuration behavior.

## Testing

Extend startup tests to cover server defaults, embedded startup, explicit override precedence, and profile launches. Verify that the first turn uses the reviewer returned by the server.

GitOrigin-RevId: 19d4d75bb8fbe522fb9495bd9c6951513f8ac4d2

commits.title: Keep TUI preferences editable when execution settings are invalid (#56091)
commits.message:
Keep TUI preferences editable when execution settings are invalid (#56091)

## Why

Saving a local preference could succeed but fail to apply live because reloading the full configuration also resolved execution settings. An unknown `model_provider`, for example, prevented the preference from taking effect.

## What changed

Reload config-panel preferences from the configuration layer stack into `LocalSettings` without rebuilding execution settings. Preserve CLI overrides, loader overrides, cloud configuration, and the existing choice of working directory.

## Testing

Extend the offline remote-session preference test with an unknown `model_provider` override, verifying that automatic recap and paste detection preferences still persist and apply live.

GitOrigin-RevId: 2377a01c77f3cb978a7ee6cd67c1fe89361131fb

commits.title: Prepare TUI startup to accept multiple backend sessions (#56097)
commits.message:
Prepare TUI startup to accept multiple backend sessions (#56097)

## What changed

- Add `InitialBackendSessions` to carry the initial session and additional sessions into the TUI event loop. Existing launches continue to supply a single session.
- Shut down all supplied sessions on startup errors, cancellation, and early exits.
- Register the under-development `tui_multi_backend` feature flag, disabled by default, and expose it in the configuration schema.

## Testing

Add a regression test that fails bootstrap and verifies that both initial backends receive shutdown requests. Update multi-source event polling coverage to use the new initialization path.

commits.title: Forward Guardian reviewer events to parent raw-event subscribers (#56124)
commits.message:
Forward Guardian reviewer events to parent raw-event subscribers (#56124)

## What changed

Add the disabled-by-default `guardian_recorded_items` feature to forward recorded reviewer items and interruptions through the parent's raw-event subscription, preserving reviewer thread and turn IDs without modifying the parent's history or completing its turn.

Emit reviewer items as `rawResponseItem/completed` notifications and interruptions as interrupted `turn/completed` notifications. Mark opted-in reviewer requests with `guardian_recorded_items` metadata.

## Testing

Extend Guardian integration tests to cover reviewer identity, recorded-item metadata replay, concurrent reviewer interruptions, independent parent completion, and behavior without the feature enabled.

GitOrigin-RevId: beb4dbf6c6f2a800a2fbf3cfd11ae174a1382386

commits.title: Avoid blocking EMA auth status checks on account refresh (#56127)
commits.message:
Avoid blocking EMA auth status checks on account refresh (#56127)

## Why

EMA MCP auth status checks acquired an account grant lease, making status inspection wait for account refresh coordination or an existing lease.

## What changed

Add `AuthManager::account_oauth_grant()` to inspect an owner-checked grant without acquiring the refresh lock. Use it for EMA status checks and share a single lazy read across servers, including missing grants and read errors. Keep refresh exclusion for token exchanges through `lease_account_oauth_grant()`.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for status checks across two EMA servers while an account lease is held. Extend account refresh tests to verify inspection completes with a lease held and refresh queued, and returns no grant after logout.

commits.title: Cancel MCP tool requests when response futures are dropped (#56132)
commits.message:
Cancel MCP tool requests when response futures are dropped (#56132)

## Why

Dropping a local tool-call future did not notify the MCP server that the request was cancelled, leaving remote work running.

## What changed

- Send a cancellation notification for the request when its response future is dropped, covering both ordinary tool calls and tool-input rounds.
- Preserve write order for stdio and in-process transports so cancellation cannot arrive before its tool request, without waiting for tool responses.

## Testing

Add regression tests for cancellation on drop, request-before-cancellation ordering under reversed send polling and exhausted task budgets, and continued use of the shared connection after cancellation.

commits.title: Defer agent mail after empty final answers (#56133)
commits.message:
Defer agent mail after empty final answers (#56133)

## Why

An explicit `final_answer` with empty or whitespace-only text could allow queued agent mail to restart the turn instead of leaving it queued for the next turn.

## What changed

Treat explicit `final_answer` messages as terminal regardless of visible text in both completed-item handling and turn-item finalization. Untagged messages still require visible text to defer mailbox delivery; `commentary` and `partial_answer` messages do not defer it.

## Testing

Extend regression coverage for empty and whitespace-only final answers, delivery of queued agent mail on the next turn, and message board notifications arriving before or after an empty final answer.

commits.title: Preserve safe enterprise MCP authentication error details (#56153)
commits.message:
Preserve safe enterprise MCP authentication error details (#56153)

## Why

Enterprise MCP token exchange and sign-in failures can collapse into generic errors, hiding useful diagnostics such as an OAuth `invalid_scope` rejection or a cancelled sign-in.

## What changed

Introduce `EmaErrorDetail` to carry static operation messages and sanitized SDK diagnostics through token-source errors and enterprise login completion. Exchange failures can report the stage, HTTP status, and allowlisted OAuth error code, such as `IdentityProvider: HTTP 400: invalid_scope`, without retaining arbitrary provider text or raw error chains.

Preserve specific discovery, credential storage, cancellation, and account/configuration mismatch errors instead of replacing them with generic failure messages.

## Testing

Extend tests to cover `invalid_scope` diagnostics, specific sign-in completion errors, and exclusion of credentials from diagnostics even when an outer error context contains sensitive text.

commits.title: Add managed network review domains before allow rules (#56154)
commits.message:
Add managed network review domains before allow rules (#56154)

## Why

Managed network policies need to require approval for selected hosts even when an exact or wildcard allow rule matches them.

## What changed

- Add `experimental_network.review_domains` to managed requirements and route matching hosts through the existing network approval flow. Explicit denials retain precedence, and approved connections still undergo DNS and local-address checks.
- Preserve review patterns across environment policy attachments and remote proxy configuration. Reject execution on an exec-server that lacks the `networkProxyReviewDomains` capability when review patterns are present.
- Expose `reviewDomains` through the app-server requirements API and generated schemas, and show `review_domains` in debug configuration output.
- Update approval reasons to say that network access requires approval rather than assuming the host is absent from the allowlist.

## Testing

Extend coverage for review precedence over exact and wildcard allows, explicit denials, DNS checks after local and remote approvals, approval hooks, policy merging, remote configuration round trips, and requirements API serialization.

commits.title: Add AWS SigV4 signing to network proxy MITM hooks (#56182)
commits.message:
Add AWS SigV4 signing to network proxy MITM hooks (#56182)

## Why

Allow workloads to make AWS requests with placeholder credentials while keeping real AWS credentials in the trusted proxy process.

## What changed

- Add an `aws_sigv4` hook action with a placeholder access key ID, region, service, HTTPS port, and credential sources from proxy environment variables or files.
- Re-sign matching requests after network and hook authorization and header transformations, using the configured credentials and optional session token.
- Support empty payloads and explicitly unsigned payloads, including streaming unsigned S3 uploads. Reject selected requests with incompatible credential scopes, presigned URLs, unsupported streaming signatures, or ambiguous framing through the hook denial path.
- Mark generated credential headers as sensitive and suppress signing SDK trace events that could expose credentials.

## Testing

Add tests for the published AWS IAM signature vector, unsigned S3 uploads with a session token, and rejection of invalid transport, credential scopes, signing inputs, and unsupported bodies.

commits.title: Stabilize the marketplace staging cleanup test (#56210)
commits.message:
Stabilize the marketplace staging cleanup test (#56210)

## Why

A concurrent fork can retain locks from a previous cleanup pass until exec,
causing the next pass to skip cleanup and fail the test's assertions.

## What changed

Wait for and explicitly release both staging locks before each cleanup pass in
`cleanup_reclaims_unpublished_and_aged_legacy_clones`. Run the existing age
scenarios in a loop and report the age when legacy directory assertions fail.

commits.message:

## Why

Profiles without a v1 memory workspace have no legacy context to preserve or consolidate before using v2.

## What changed

- Select v2 when memories are enabled and the `memories` directory is absent. Preserve explicit `memories.version` settings, the `memories.dual_write = false` opt-out, and the v1 default for existing workspaces or filesystem check errors.
- Report `v2_ready` immediately for profiles without a v1 workspace. Keep the consolidation count and valid-summary requirements for profiles with a v1 workspace.
- Make resetting an absent memory workspace a no-op so it does not create an unused v1 directory.

## Testing

Extend coverage for default and explicit version selection, opt-outs, version-specific memory reads, fresh-profile readiness and reset behavior, and running only the v2 pipeline for fresh profiles.

commits.title: Isolate V8 source dependencies and their C++ runtime settings (#56261)
commits.message:
Isolate V8 source dependencies and their C++ runtime settings (#56261)

## Why

V8's Abseil and protobuf's shared Abseil can be built for different C++ runtimes. Give V8's copy a distinct inline namespace so both can link into one binary without interposing incompatible functions.

## What changed

- Move pinned V8 dependency imports and BUILD overlays into `third_party/v8`, and inject those repositories into V8 through a module-extension bridge with no fallback downloads.
- Build V8's Abseil with a V8-specific inline namespace while preserving protobuf's shared Abseil namespace.

## Why

The network proxy previously required AWS signing requests to have an empty body or use `UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD`, preventing signing of nonempty payloads.

## What changed

- Buffer and hash request bodies before signing, then forward the original bytes.

- Limit concurrent buffering to eight requests with a five-second capacity wait. Retain reservations while forwarded body data remains alive.
- Reject trailers and mismatched content lengths for buffered payloads while preserving streaming for explicitly unsigned payloads.

## Testing

Add coverage for payload hashing and forwarding, body limits and timeouts, fragmented body collection, and buffer reservation lifetimes. Extend signing tests for S3 path and query canonicalization, header replacement, and secret exclusion from trace logs.

commits.title: Prevent memory imports from racing with consolidation (#56462)
commits.message:
Prevent memory imports from racing with consolidation (#56462)

## Why

Concurrent imports and consolidation can modify the same memory workspace, leaving a partial import across memory versions or interfering with consolidation snapshots and baselines.

## What changed

- Add a cross-process workspace lock shared by memory imports and consolidation.
- Acquire locks for every import destination before modifying any workspace. Return a retryable busy error if a destination is locked, and skip consolidation when its workspace is busy.
- Hold locks through import completion even if the caller drops the future, and through consolidation agent termination and baseline finalization.

## Testing

Add an app-server integration test that blocks an active consolidation, verifies import rejection without partial writes or snapshot changes, then retries successfully and confirms imported resources remain visible to the next consolidation.

## Why

The network proxy previously required AWS signing requests to have an empty body or use `UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD`, preventing signing of nonempty payloads.

## What changed

- Buffer and hash request bodies before signing, then forward the original bytes.

- Limit concurrent buffering to eight requests with a five-second capacity wait. Retain reservations while forwarded body data remains alive.
- Reject trailers and mismatched content lengths for buffered payloads while preserving streaming for explicitly unsigned payloads.

## Testing

Add coverage for payload hashing and forwarding, body limits and timeouts, fragmented body collection, and buffer reservation lifetimes. Extend signing tests for S3 path and query canonicalization, header replacement, and secret exclusion from trace logs.

commits.title: Prevent memory imports from racing with consolidation (#56462)
commits.message:
Prevent memory imports from racing with consolidation (#56462)

## Why

Concurrent imports and consolidation can modify the same memory workspace, leaving a partial import across memory versions or interfering with consolidation snapshots and baselines.

## What changed

- Add a cross-process workspace lock shared by memory imports and consolidation.
- Acquire locks for every import destination before modifying any workspace. Return a retryable busy error if a destination is locked, and skip consolidation when its workspace is busy.
- Hold locks through import completion even if the caller drops the future, and through consolidation agent termination and baseline finalization.

## Testing

Add an app-server integration test that blocks an active consolidation, verifies import rejection without partial writes or snapshot changes, then retries successfully and confirms imported resources remain visible to the next consolidation.

commits.title: Support bounded request bodies in AWS SigV4 signing (#56277)

## Why

The network proxy previously required AWS signing requests to have an empty body or use `UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD`, preventing signing of nonempty payloads.

## What changed

- Buffer and hash request bodies before signing, then forward the original bytes.
- Add `max_body_bytes` with an 8 MiB default and a 16 MiB maximum, plus a 30-second body read timeout.
- Limit concurrent buffering to eight requests with a five-second capacity wait. Retain reservations while forwarded body data remains alive.
- Reject trailers and mismatched content lengths for buffered payloads while preserving streaming for explicitly unsigned payloads.

## Testing

Add coverage for payload hashing and forwarding, body limits and timeouts, fragmented body collection, and buffer reservation lifetimes. Extend signing tests for S3 path and query canonicalization, header replacement, and secret exclusion from trace logs.

Add TLS forwarding tests for MITM SigV4 requests (#56301)

## What changed

Add a test-only MITM CA constructor and local TLS origin fixtures to exercise AWS SigV4 forwarding:

- Check `aoss` payload hashes and credential replacement for GET and POST requests, while preserving unsigned requests and requests using another access key.
- Verify rejection of unsupported HTTP/1.1 framing and signing headers, and check the forwarded body, payload hash, and signed header presence at an HTTP/2 origin.
- Verify that draining signed request bodies releases buffering capacity before response headers arrive, allowing a ninth request to complete while eight responses remain pending.

commits.title: Separate directory and repository scopes in the TUI (#56308)
commits.message:
Separate directory and repository scopes in the TUI (#56308)

## Why

The `Cwd` session filter included sessions from linked worktrees, leaving no way to restrict the picker to the current directory. Project grouping also combined tasks across linked worktrees.

## What changed

- Keep `Cwd` filtering and directory-scoped `resume --last` and `fork --last` lookups limited to the current directory.
- Add an explicit `Repo` picker filter when multiple local worktrees are available, including sessions from corresponding directories across linked worktrees. Cycle between `Cwd`, `Repo`, and `All` in either direction.
- Add `Directory` grouping to the agent command center alongside `Project`, `Status`, and `Model`. Keep this choice in memory without writing a configuration value older clients cannot read.

## Testing

Extend coverage for directory and repository filtering, pagination scope, linked-worktree grouping, directory aliases, grouping persistence, and adjacent selection after task removal. Update picker and command center snapshots.

commits.title: Track accepted conversation history in rollout traces (#56312)
commits.message:
Track accepted conversation history in rollout traces (#56312)

## Why

Model output alone does not establish that an item entered conversation history. Treating every response item as accepted can include discarded attempts, while relying on a later request misses accepted final output when a turn ends or is interrupted.

## What changed

- Record `HistoryItemAccepted` events and retain Responses item IDs, generating missing IDs consistently across item events.
- Build thread conversation history from request inputs, compaction checkpoints, and explicit acceptance. Keep unaccepted output accessible through its inference call.
- Preserve inference provenance across retries and late response records without overwriting newer request or compaction snapshots.
- Mark turns with errors as failed. Bump trace schemas to version 2 and reject incompatible bundles and event schemas during replay.

## Testing

Add reducer coverage for discarded attempts with identical text, late responses, compaction, inherited context, and legacy bundle rejection. Add CLI integration tests that run `debug trace-reduce` after success, stream failure, and interruption followed by shutdown, including responses without provider item IDs.

commits.title: Make agent-message wakes respect interrupts and Plan mode (#56330)
commits.message:
Make agent-message wakes respect interrupts and Plan mode (#56330)

## Why

A pending agent-message wake can outlive an interrupt or a switch to Plan mode while model discovery is waiting. It must recheck whether it can start before consuming queued messages.

## What changed

- Revalidate reserved wakes after discovery and build the turn with the configuration selected during admission.
- Mark interrupted wake reservations as stopped so later agent messages cannot restart automatic work, while preserving queued messages for explicit turns.
- Keep finishing turns marked as running until completion is persisted, protecting their rollout writer from capacity eviction.

## Testing

Add regression tests for interrupts and Plan-mode changes during discovery, queued-message preservation, explicit follow-ups with `wake_on_agent_messages` disabled, and completion status and persistence with the feature enabled and disabled.

commits.message:
Match rollout trace image content across request snapshots (#56342)

## Why

Repeated image outputs in different request payloads could fail replay with a call ID reuse error even when their content was unchanged.

## What changed

- Hash canonical JSON for non-text content parts and compare their `content_sha256` values independently of payload location.
- Preserve empty content arrays as empty bodies so they also match across snapshots.

## Testing

Add a regression test verifying that repeated image and empty tool outputs reuse conversation items, while changed image content with the same call and item IDs still fails replay.

commits.title: Support memory v2 in external-agent memory imports (#56414)
commits.message:
Support memory v2 in external-agent memory imports (#56414)

## Why

External-agent memory imports previously wrote only to the v1 workspace and queued only v1 consolidation, leaving the v2 pipeline without imported resources.

## What changed

- Always import selected resources into `memories_v2`. Also update `memories` when v1 is selected or a legacy workspace exists.
- Read `memories.version` for detection and import, detect pending changes across the applicable namespaces, and enqueue consolidation separately for each updated namespace.
- Combine project results across namespaces so cleanup in either can succeed while failures in either are reported.
- Adapt imported-memory consolidation instructions to the active pipeline's output format.

## Testing

Expand app-server integration coverage for v2 profiles, explicit v1 selection, default profiles, and existing legacy workspaces. Verify resource copies, consolidation queues, repeat detection, and cleanup of deleted or unscoped projects.

commits.message:
Make the Realtime V2 background-agent steering test deterministic (#56453)

## Why

The steering test needs to deliver guidance after the first Responses request starts and ensure it is routed before releasing the blocked response. A steering acknowledgement alone does not establish that routing has completed.

commits.title: Make sandbox mount cleanup tests tolerate file descriptor reuse (#56454)
commits.message:
Make sandbox mount cleanup tests tolerate file descriptor reuse (#56454)

## Why

Concurrent tests can reuse a closed file descriptor number, causing cleanup assertions that require `EBADF` to fail even when the inherited directory descriptor was closed.

## What changed

Capture the inherited directory's device and inode before mount verification. Check `/proc/self/fd` afterward and accept either a missing descriptor or one referring to a different inode, while still rejecting a leaked descriptor to the original directory. Apply this check to successful verification and rejected mount markers.

commits.title: Add silent append support to message boards (#56461)
commits.message:
Add silent append support to message boards (#56461)

## Why

Recording evidence on a message board needs a write operation that does not automatically subscribe the author or notify existing subscribers.

## What changed

- Add `AppendRequest` and `AgentMessageBoard::append` for local and in-memory boards, supporting new channels, existing channels, and thread replies without subscription or notification side effects.
- Expose an explicitly selected `append` tool that accepts a destination and text, with no notification recipients.
- Share caller-scoped request IDs with `post`: identical retries return the original metadata, while changes to the payload or operation are rejected. Local appends retain write permission checks and durable storage.
- Reject remote appends as unsupported without issuing an HTTP request.

## Testing

Add coverage for silent writes on both supported backends, tool argument validation and retry conflicts, local read-only access and retries after reopening storage, and remote rejection without network requests.

commits.title: Prevent memory imports from racing with consolidation (#56462)
commits.message:
Prevent memory imports from racing with consolidation (#56462)

## Why

Concurrent imports and consolidation can modify the same memory workspace, leaving a partial import across memory versions or interfering with consolidation snapshots and baselines.

## What changed

- Add a cross-process workspace lock shared by memory imports and consolidation.
- Acquire locks for every import destination before modifying any workspace. Return a retryable busy error if a destination is locked, and skip consolidation when its workspace is busy.
- Hold locks through import completion even if the caller drops the future, and through consolidation agent termination and baseline finalization.

## Testing

Add an app-server integration test that blocks an active consolidation, verifies import rejection without partial writes or snapshot changes, then retries successfully and confirms imported resources remain visible to the next consolidation.
